prs.tagLine: Discover Luxury Living in the Heart of Castleknock
prs.location:
Prime Location 

Balroy Hall is situated in the vibrant community of Castleknock, offering a perfect blend of urban convenience and suburban tranquility. Discover the local attractions and amenities that make Castleknock a sought-after location: 

Local Places of Interest: 

Phoenix Park: One of Europe's largest enclosed parks, perfect for picnics, jogging, and outdoor activities. Home to the Dublin Zoo, Aras un Uachtarain and countless historical landlmarks. 

Farmleigh House: A stunning historic estate offering guided tours, beautiful gardens, art exhibitions and cultural events. 

Castleknock Golf Club: Enjoy a round of golf at this prestigious 18-hole course set in picturesque surroundings. Also close to Luttrellstown Castle Golf and Country Club. 

Nearby Amenities: 

Shopping and Dining: Explore an array of shops, cafes, and restaurants in Castleknock Village and nearby Blanchardstown Centre. 

Excellent Schools: A selection of top-rated primary and secondary schools within easy reach. 

Convenient Transportation: Excellent transport links including the Castleknock train station, multiple bus routes, and easy access to the M50 motorway. 

Healthcare: Nearby to healthcare facilities including Connolly Hospital Blanchardstown and various local clinics. 

Schools: Proximity to excellent educational institutions including Castleknock College, Mount Sackville Secondary School and several primary schools.

description:
Balroy Hall offers an exclusive selection of brand-new, A-rated apartments designed for
modern living. Nestled in the charming neighborhood of Castleknock, our residences
combine elegant design, top-notch amenities, and a prime location to deliver an unparalleled
living experience.

Exceptional Apartments

Our apartments are thoughtfully designed to provide comfort and style. Each unit features:
 Spacious Living Areas: Open-concept layouts with high ceilings and large windows
for natural light.
 Modern Kitchens: Fully equipped with premium appliances, sleek cabinetry, and
elegant countertops.
 Luxurious Bedrooms: Comfortable and serene spaces with ample storage.
 Energy Efficiency: A-rated for energy efficiency, ensuring lower utility bills and a
greener lifestyle.
 Private Balconies: Enjoy your morning coffee with scenic views of Castleknock.

First-Class Amenities
At Balroy Hall, our residents enjoy a range of high-end amenities designed to enhance their
lifestyle:
 State-of-the-Art Gym: Stay fit and healthy with our fully equipped fitness center.
 MyPup Parcel Storage: Convenient and secure parcel delivery and storage service.
 Private Parking: Ample parking spaces for residents and guests.
 Children's Play Area: Engaging play spaces for children.
